frozen_methods.public_self_loop: exact before digest equals after digest (can include legitimate no-op actions)
frozen_methods.pickup_visual: only selected pickup action 3, original source-public front object 5/6/7 before and public empty cell type 1 after
frozen_methods.drop_visual: only selected drop action 4, front empty before and portable object 5/6/7 after
frozen_methods.door_unlock_visual: only selected toggle action 5, same front public door object and color, locked (2) before, open (0) after
frozen_methods.door_open_visual: only selected toggle action 5, same front public door object and color, closed (1) before, open (0) after
frozen_methods.door_close_visual: only selected toggle action 5, same front public door object and color, open (0) before, closed (1) after
frozen_methods.original_mission_target_pickup: source-public mission 'pick up the <color> <object>' and exact front portable object index/color disappear on selected original pickup action 3
frozen_methods.delayed_chain: within same original episode: a source-public pickup effect, later door open effect, strictly later positive terminated original source reward; only public observed temporal order NOT proven causation
frozen_methods.repeated_object_manipulation: count further public selected pickup/drop after first public pickup, with no inference of inventory across frames
frozen_methods.action_policy_agreement: same original chosen action sequence within same seed/family at aligned steps; identical full chain if lengths/actions/public/reward all identical
frozen_methods.cold_retention: report original checkpoint hashes and previous/next selected sample counts only; do not independently assert persistence of physical inventory
